title: Subject Matter Expert - Data Science
description:
**Company Description** 
 FACE Prep is one of India’s largest placement\-focused skill development companies, helping students prepare for careers in the tech sector. Since 2008, the organization has supported millions of learners in launching their professional journeys through structured, industry\-relevant training. FACE Prep offers masterclasses, self\-paced programs, workshops, and bootcamps designed to build job\-ready skills and improve placement outcomes. Its alumni work across leading global technology companies such as Google, Microsoft, Meta, Adobe, PayPal, Amazon, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Thought Works, Cognizant, and Accenture.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Subject Matter Expert – Data Science will design and deliver high\-quality learning content, including curricula, lesson plans, problem sets, and projects that align with current industry standards. This full\-time, on\-site role based in Coimbatore involves teaching and mentoring students, explaining complex data science concepts in an accessible manner, and supporting them in interview and placement preparation. The role includes collaborating with internal teams to update materials based on feedback and emerging trends, creating assessments to evaluate learner progress, and contributing to workshops, bootcamps, and online resources. The Subject Matter Expert will also review and refine course content, participate in internal training sessions, and ensure a consistent, engaging learning experience across programs.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and a problem\-solving mindset.
* Candidates should possess solid knowledge of Statistics and its application in real\-world scenarios.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Data Science, including machine learning concepts and model evaluation.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in Data Analytics and Data Analysis for deriving insights from structured and unstructured data.
* Relevant experience with programming languages and tools commonly used in data science (such as Python, R, SQL, and data visualization libraries) is beneficial.
* Prior experience in teaching, training, or mentoring learners in technical subjects is an advantage.
* A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Strong communication skills, the ability to explain complex topics clearly, and a collaborative working style are essential.

title: Data Science SME
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 FACE Prep is one of India’s largest placement\-focused skill development companies, specializing in job preparation for the tech sector. Since 2008, the organization has supported millions of students in kickstarting their careers through structured training and guidance. FACE Prep offers masterclasses, self\-paced preparation programs, and intensive workshops and bootcamps designed to build in\-demand technical and professional skills. Its alumni work across the globe in leading technology companies such as Google, Microsoft, Meta, Adobe, PayPal, Amazon, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Thoughtworks, Cognizant, and Accenture. FACE Prep continues to expand its impact by partnering with learners who aim for top\-paying roles in technology.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 The Data Science Subject Matter Expert (SME) will design and deliver high\-quality learning content and training sessions focused on data science and analytics for students preparing for tech careers. This full\-time, on\-site role in Coimbatore involves developing curricula, creating problem sets, case studies, and real\-world projects, and conducting interactive classes, workshops, and doubt\-clearing sessions. The SME will review and update course materials to reflect current industry standards, tools, and best practices, ensuring content is accurate, practical, and engaging. The role also includes evaluating learner performance, providing constructive feedback, mentoring students on career paths in data science, and collaborating with other trainers and product teams to improve program effectiveness. The SME is expected to stay current with emerging trends in data science and contribute ideas to enhance FACE Prep’s training offerings.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Strong foundation in core Data Science and Data Analytics concepts, and the ability to apply them to real\-world problems.
* Proficiency in Data Analysis techniques and tools, with the ability to interpret and communicate insights clearly.
* Solid understanding of Statistics, including descriptive and inferential methods relevant to data\-driven decision\-making.
* Demonstrated Analytical Skills for problem\-solving, model evaluation, and designing data\-driven learning content.
* Hands\-on experience with programming languages commonly used in data science (such as Python or R) and relevant libraries.
* Familiarity with machine learning workflows, data visualization tools, and basic data engineering concepts.
* Prior experience in teaching, mentoring, corporate training, or curriculum development in data science or analytics is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
